screens.purpose: Land directly on the project: round tree, agent rows, round cost.
Run and converse with one pipeline agent (Brainstormer) in the dev-tool register.
Open and read any artifact from any round without leaving the app.

surfaces.name: Status Bar & Primary Nav
inputs: nav links: Project, Artifacts, Settings, Docs (Docs is the one external link; Settings opens the existing model/provider change flow)
working-directory path: a control that opens the directory picker at the current project (btn-status-bar-dir); rendered as plain text when no directory is open
surfaces.output: Status strip (directory · round · provider · model · version) and nav with one active entry, recomputed on every render

surfaces.name: Round Tree
inputs: artifact line link (opens Artifact View at that file)
surfaces.output: Ordered artifact list with lane colour, status flag (needs update / missing) and three-item legend; lanes come from the reviewed table in layouts/_round_tree.py (ROUND_ARTIFACTS), not from the mock's sample data — deployment-plan.md is in the record lane

surfaces.name: Agent Rows
inputs: action button per agent: Start, Continue and Required are filled green (the same variant); Modify is a neutral outline with green text; Needs Update is a warn outline; Not Ready is a disabled outline. Activating a button routes to that agent exactly as today; Continue resumes an in-progress conversation
surfaces.output: Seven rows: agent, produces, last model, tokens this round, action

surfaces.name: Round Cost
surfaces.output: Three-line strip: labelled estimate + tokens, priced/unpriced calls named, LiteLLM note

surfaces.name: Pipeline Indicator
surfaces.output: Seven agent names as plain text: active (accent, underline), done/reachable (full weight), unreachable (dimmed); no arrows, no Back

surfaces.name: Transcript
surfaces.output: Bordered, independently scrollable panel (~60vh) of speaker-labelled blocks; agent JSON output as mono code block on panel colour
surfaces.affordance: Speaker-labelled message blocks; user blocks carry a 2px neutral left rule and keep className chat-bubble-user (the scroll-to-latest clientside callback selects on it)
surfaces.invocation: Rendered when the chat frame opens and on each new message

surfaces.name: Run Cost
surfaces.output: Same three-line cost strip as Round Cost, scoped to this run

surfaces.name: Action Row
inputs: per-agent buttons exactly as the existing _chat_action_buttons defines them, minus every '← Back to X' button. Variant rule: the Continue/Send-to-next button is the only filled-green button; Fast Forward, Download, Open, Re-scan Project and the 'Continue to Designer' skip are neutral outlines, Re-scan in the warn tone
mid-run: chars counter · elapsed (mono, dimmed) · Fast Forward (outline) with its info modal unchanged
run complete: chars · turn tokens · elapsed (mono, dimmed) · Open {artifact} (outline, opens the Artifact View at that file) · Download {artifact} (outline) · continue button(s)
surfaces.output: Mono dimmed counters left; actions right. The mock draws the run-complete state

surfaces.name: Progress Signal
surfaces.output: 4px striped bar, accent at reduced opacity on panel colour, animating while a stream is live; hidden otherwise; the only moving element. The mock draws it alongside the run-complete action row for visibility — in the app the two do not appear together

surfaces.name: Composer
surfaces.output: Reply appended to the transcript and sent to the active agent
surfaces.affordance: Three-line textarea with Send button at the right end
surfaces.invocation: User types a reply and presses Send

surfaces.name: Model Chip & Status Line
surfaces.output:
Model name in mono inside a neutral outline pill with 'change' as dimmed text; dimmed mono status line at right ('Brainstormer is replying
' only while a stream is live)

surfaces.name: Round Selector
inputs: round links v0 v1 v2 v3
surfaces.output: Rounds on disk as mono text, active round marked like the active nav item

surfaces.name: Artifact Tree
surfaces.output: Round tree exactly as the project view draws it, with the selected file in accent text

surfaces.name: Content Pane
inputs: Open rendered (neutral outline; design/mock.html only; opens the mock in a new tab via the existing blob pattern)
surfaces.output: Mono header (path · size · modified · lane) then the file: pretty-printed JSON, dimmed line-number gutter, 1px rule, scrolling inside the block

surfaces.name: Pane State Insets
surfaces.output: Two small insets showing the pane's empty state and missing state

shared_layout.nav: 40px status bar: Spec4 wordmark, mono context strip (directory · round · provider · model), right-aligned text nav Project · Artifacts · Settings · Docs with one accent-underlined active entry, then version
shell: Dash routing via app_constants.PATH_TO_PHASE: / (project view or directory picker), /chat, /artifacts; the mock's hash router only stands in for this
single 1100px max-width content column; the Artifact View uses a 300px left column inside it
